prd_row: Section 14 acceptance table, 'Recommendations': backtested hit-rate vs. buy-and-hold, documented with transparent contributing signals.
metric_definition: Hit-rate is the share of held-out sessions on which the sign of the composite score agrees with the sign of the realised return from that session to the next. Buy-and-hold is the baseline: its implied position is long every session, so its hit-rate is the share of sessions each asset rose.
interpretation: The recommendation engine trails buy-and-hold by 2.58 percentage points, so the recommendations would have been a net negative against simply holding.
